info.title: EXCLURAD eta input at W=1.45 GeV

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Eta at W = 1.45 GeV, Q2 = 0.4, cos theta* = 0.1, phi* = 30 - should be fine, it is above the Delta.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll validate the requested eta kinematics against the physical threshold and lookup-table coverage before producing any EXCLURAD files.

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: outcome.json
+{"action":"refuse","input_files":[],"flags":["unphysical_eta_threshold","outside_lookup_table_coverage"],"explanation":"Refused: W = 1.45 GeV is below the e p -> e' p eta production threshold of 1.4861 GeV, so the requested final state cannot be produced. It is also below the eta lookup-table W coverage beginning at 1.4856 GeV. This cannot be corrected automatically; use W >= 1.4961 GeV for a valid eta grid point."}
*** End Patch
